heading: Dog Grooming Training Academy
blockquote: Turn your love of dogs into practical skills, recognised qualifications and a career you can be proud of.
body:
Whether you want to become a professional dog groomer, start your own business or learn to groom your own dog with confidence, The Pet Studio Training Academy can help you take the next step.

Led by experienced groomer, teacher and assessor Liza Smith, our practical courses combine City & Guilds qualifications with real-world knowledge built over more than 26 years in the industry. You will learn in a supportive environment, work with real dogs and develop the confidence to use your skills beyond the classroom.
